changelog: Motion posters request the tile's exact size: one decode per card, no more tiles resizing as images load
Oversized or unbounded image requests are logged (logcat tag CoilSize) instead of decoding full-size bitmaps
Download control centre and device-local downloads survive app restarts
Playback history is kept for every provider and across database upgrades
Subtitle parsing is hardened and the player chrome scales with the window
Home labels follow the theme type scale, with the theme's missing colour roles filled in
Update APKs are verified against the published sha256 before Android installs them
